english: Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be defined by $f(x)=x^{2}-4x$, and let $h:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be defined by $h(x)=\max\left\{f(|x|),\ \dfrac{x-5}{2}\right\}$. Then the least value of $h$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, $f(x)=x^{2}-4x$ द्वारा परिभाषित है, तथा $h:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, $h(x)=\max\left\{f(|x|),\ \dfrac{x-5}{2}\right\}$ द्वारा परिभाषित है। तब $h$ का न्यूनतम मान ______ है।
solution: $f(|x|)=x^{2}-4|x|$: the graph of $f$ for $x\ge0$ reflected in the $y$-axis; minimum $-4$ at $x=\pm2$. Let $L(x)=\dfrac{x-5}{2}$; $h\ge L$ and $h\ge f(|x|)$
On $\left[-\dfrac52,-1\right]$ the parabola is below the line, so $h=L$, increasing: least $L\left(-\dfrac52\right)=-\dfrac{15}{4}$
solution_full: For $x\ge0$, $f(|x|)=x^{2}-4x$, and for $x<0$, $f(|x|)=x^{2}+4x$. So the graph of $y=f(|x|)$ is the part of $y=x^{2}-4x$ for $x\ge0$ together with its mirror image in the $y$-axis: a W-shaped curve with minimum $-4$ at $x=\pm2$, passing through $(0,0)$ and $(\pm4,0)$.
Let $L(x)=\dfrac{x-5}{2}$. The graph of $h$ is the upper of the two graphs, so $h(x)\ge L(x)$ and $h(x)\ge f(|x|)$ for all $x$.
For $x\ge0$: $h(x)\ge L(x)\ge L(0)=-\dfrac52$. (At $x=2$, $L(2)=-\dfrac32>-4$, so the bottom of the right arc is covered by the line.)
For $x<0$: the left arc meets the line where $x^{2}+4x=\dfrac{x-5}{2}$, i.e. $2x^{2}+7x+5=0$, $(2x+5)(x+1)=0$, $x=-\dfrac52$ or $x=-1$.

For $-\dfrac52\le x\le-1$, $x^{2}+4x\le\dfrac{x-5}{2}$ (the quadratic $2x^{2}+7x+5\le0$ there), so $h(x)=L(x)$, which is increasing; its least value on this interval is $L\left(-\dfrac52\right)=-\dfrac{15}{4}$.
For $x<-\dfrac52$: $h(x)\ge x^{2}+4x$, and $x^{2}+4x$ is decreasing on $(-\infty,-2]$, so $x^{2}+4x>\left(-\dfrac52\right)^{2}+4\left(-\dfrac52\right)=-\dfrac{15}{4}$.

Combining all cases, $h(x)\ge-\dfrac{15}{4}$ with equality at $x=-\dfrac52$. The range of $h$ is $\left[-\dfrac{15}{4},\infty\right)$ and the least value is $-3.75$. (Using $f(x)$ instead of $f(|x|)$ would give the irrational value $L\left(\dfrac{9-\sqrt{41}}{4}\right)$.)
originality_note: New: least value of the maximum of a W-shaped graph f(|x|) and a slanting line; the line hides the right well, and the minimum sits at an intersection on the left arc, not at a bottom of either graph (way 5). Closest known: max/min of two graphs and graphs of f(|x|). Different because: the answer comes from the reflected arc only, so the graph of f(|x|) is essential.

concept_use.Domain and range of functions involving: Range of h = max{f(|x|), L}: h >= both, and the least value -15/4 is found at the crossing x = -5/2 where the maximum switches from the parabola to the line.
concept_use.Graphs of |f(x)|, f(|x|), |f(|x|)| and m: The graph of f(|x|) is the right half of y = x^2 - 4x reflected in the y-axis; only its left arc x^2 + 4x meets the line where the minimum of h occurs.

key_step: Seeing that the minimum of the maximum is at the left crossing x = -5/2 of the reflected arc and the line.
justification: Needs the graph of f(|x|), the upper envelope with a line and a case split on both sides; numerical answer. Comparable to 2026-P1-Q1 (L3) in being a two-idea function analysis with a sign/region decision.
